lead: Thirty days with the whole system, your own practice name on it and nobody chasing you. What follows is the complete list of conditions — there is not a longer version somewhere else.
note: Trial practices get the same support as paying ones. If thirty days is not enough because a colleague is on holiday, write and ask; we extend it more often than we refuse.

terms.title: How long
terms.text: From the day the practice is created, not from the day somebody first signs in.

terms.title: Payment details
terms.text: No card, no bank details, no mandate. There is nothing to remember to cancel.

terms.title: What is limited
terms.text: Everything else is the full Praxis plan, including insurance billing and reminders.

terms.title: SMS during the trial
terms.text: Enough to see how reminders behave. After that they simply stop sending.

terms.title: Real patient data
terms.text: A data-processing agreement is issued automatically when the practice is created, before anything can be entered.

terms.title: On the last day
terms.text: The practice becomes read-only. Nothing is charged and no subscription starts by itself.

terms.title: If you continue
terms.text: Choose a plan and the appointments, documents and settings from the trial carry straight over.

terms.title: If you do not
terms.text: The export stays available for 60 days, after which the practice is deleted and we confirm it in writing.
